mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_plan (user_id, title, goal, dataset_id, model_config_id, status, steps_json, report_title, report_content, report_generator_type, report_charts_json) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{goal}, #{datasetId}, #{modelConfigId}, #{status}, #{stepsJson}, #{reportTitle}, #{reportContent}, #{reportGeneratorType}, #{reportChartsJson})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, goal, dataset_id, model_config_id, status, steps_json, report_title, report_content, report_generator_type, report_charts_json, create_time, update_time FROM agent_plan WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, user_id, title, goal, dataset_id, model_config_id, status, steps_json, report_title, report_content, report_generator_type, report_charts_json, create_time, update_time FROM agent_plan WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT id, user_id, title, goal, dataset_id, model_config_id, status, steps_json, report_title, report_content, report_generator_type, report_charts_json, create_time, update_time FROM agent_plan WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND report_content IS NOT NULL AND report_content != '' ORDER BY id DESC
